_about: Settings for build_feed.py, which reads the festival schedule from Monday.com and writes data/schedule.json + data/artists.json. Only the columns listed here are ever read; nothing else leaves Monday.

2026._note: Year-end snapshot of the 2026 festival; used as sample data until 2027 is announced.

2027._note: Live Programming Schedule. public_from is null, so --publish is refused: the 2027 lineup cannot reach the public site until a date is set here and committed.

photos._note: Artist photos: the first image found in these file columns, in this order (Preferred Photo, Re-sized Band Photo, Band Photo), is downloaded, resized to max_side pixels on its long side as a JPEG of at most max_kb, and saved as assets/artists/<artist id>.jpg (preview builds: data/preview/artists/, never committed). Unchanged photos are not downloaded again.

validation._note: A set starting before this time is flagged as a probable AM/PM slip (it is a warning, not an error).
